The Chinese characters for Brenda

As a transliteration, Brenda is usually written 布伦达 (Bù lún dá). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With Norse origins, Brenda is usually read as “sword (of uncertain origin)”.

About the name Brenda

A Norse-rooted name that was a mid-century favourite.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Brenda as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “sword (of uncertain origin)”, is part of the appeal.
